scripts.dev: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run db:setup --workspace apps/api && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
